newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris says "well positioned" to grow.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris says "well positioned" to grow.

text.p: INDIANAPOLIS, Nov 19 (REUTER) - Paul Harris Stores Inc, which recorded the highest third-quarter earnings in its history, is "well positioned" to grow at a more-aggressive pace, said chairman, president and chief executive officer Charlotte Fischer.
The store earlier on Tuesday reported third quarter net income of $0.17 per share. It lost $0.06 per share during the third quarter last year.

"We continue to see significant year-to-year improvements in gross margins," Fischer said in a statement accompanying earnings. "...and we are now well positioned to pursue growth at a more aggressive pace."
The chain operates at 227 locations and has opened 17 new locations in 1996, 16 since the start of the third quarter.
Fischer tied a 55-percent increase in gross income versus the third quarter 1995 largely to a broadened merchandise mix and continued work on improving asset productivity.

In particular, she cited an outstanding customer response to a third-quarter test of a new casual collection called "PH Sport" and said the company sees opportunity to open the "PH Sport" department company-wide in 1997.
